# Orion Ledger

verification command: python -B checks/validate_repository.py
release owner: platform-reliability
artifact format: canonical-json-v2

primary_region = "eu-west-3"
release_channel = "canary-orion"
current_queue = "ledger-events-v3"

# Repository conventions

service_manifest_path: services/orion.yaml
migration_command: uv run python scripts/migrate.py --safe

# Queue recovery

failed_approach: purge-the-queue
verified_repair: pause-consumers-then-replay
verification: event counts must converge before consumers resume

# Cache recovery

failed_command: python scripts/rebuild_cache.py --all
verified_command: python -B scripts/rebuild_cache.py --bounded
verification: compare the rebuilt key count with the ledger snapshot

# Current policy

superseded listener port: 8100
current listener port: 8181
current rollback window: 12m

# Lyra API

# Contract workflow
